Source: shape: use the points of in1 (or the demo shape when unconnected). image: sample points where the in2 TOP is bright.
Points: Number of points in the cloud. Above about 8000 the neighbour search gets slow.
Linkdistance: Maximum distance between two points for a plexus line, in world units.
Longlines: Number of random long straight lines. 0 = none.
Longspread: How far the long lines reach, in world units.
Lineopacity: Opacity of the plexus lines. 0 = invisible, 1 = opaque.
Longopacity: Opacity of the long lines. Values above 1 make them brighter.
Banding: Snap of points onto horizontal slices. 0 = off, 1 = fully snapped.
Bandshift: Sideways scan offset applied per band, in world units. 0 = aligned slices.
Bandsteps: Number of glitch steps per second that change the band offsets. Lower = slower stepping.
Sweep: Strength of the scan plane that sweeps through the cloud. 0 = off.
Sweepcycles: Number of sweeps per preview loop cycle.
Jitter: Random per-point position noise, in world units. 0 = still.
Scale: Overall size of the generated cloud.
Threshold: Image luma (0-1) above which pixels can spawn points. Used when Source is image.
Imgsamples: Point density sampled from the image. Higher = more points on bright areas. Used when Source is image.
Imgdepth: Depth of the image cloud: how far points are pushed along Z by image brightness. Used when Source is image.
Demoshape: Demo shape used when in1 is unconnected. blob: head-like blob; sphere; torus.
Camdist: Preview camera distance, in world units.
Camheight: Preview camera height, in world units.
Orbitturns: Camera orbits per loop cycle. 0 = no orbit.
Orbitrange: How much of the orbit is used. 0 = fixed camera, 1 = full orbit.
Fov: Preview camera field of view in degrees.
Grid: Opacity of the cross-mark grid in the preview. 0 = off.
Gridsize: Size of the grid cross marks in the preview.
Glow: Amount of glow added to the preview. 0 = none.
